evidence_items.explanation: Across the surveyed markets, positive shifts outnumbered negative shifts, although US respondents were more negative. This challenges a geographically sweeping claim, but the sample includes non-users and measures opinion changes rather than loss of faith.

The latest completed quarter showed strong AI investment despite investor concerns. This cautions against equating anxiety with withdrawal of confidence, but it predates July and includes non-generative AI.
